title: Wynn Supports Macao's Efforts to Expand Southeast Asian Visitor Markets
summary: Macao, September 6, 2026 – Wynn actively supported the Macao Economic, Trade and Tourism Investment Promotion Seminars and related inspections and exchange activities organized by the Macao...
body_markdown:
**Macao, September 6, 2026 –** Wynn actively supported the Macao Economic, Trade and Tourism Investment Promotion Seminars and related inspections and exchange activities organized by the Macao Government Tourism Office and the Commerce and Investment Promotion Institute in Singapore, Indonesia, and Malaysia from 29 August to 5 September. Together with industry partners, Wynn promoted Macao's rich and diverse "tourism +" offerings to the Southeast Asian market, further showcasing the city's unique appeal as a World Centre of Tourism and Leisure and expanding its international visitor base.


To support this promotional campaign, Wynn launched exclusive travel offers valued at over MOP 2 million, featuring hotel accommodation, dining experiences, and leisure and entertainment offerings aimed at attracting visitors from Singapore, Indonesia, and Malaysia. In addition, Wynn took the opportunity to engage in in depth exchanges with local tourism industry stakeholders and business representatives to gain insights into market trends and visitor preferences, explore further opportunities for tourism and trade partnerships, and strengthen ties between Macao and Southeast Asian markets.


Looking ahead, Wynn will continue to support the SAR Government's efforts to promote the high-quality development of the tourism industry by continuously enriching and innovating its tourism products and experiences while expanding into diverse visitor markets. Through these efforts, the company seeks to further enhance Macao's appeal as an international tourism destination and inject new momentum into the city's appropriate economic diversification.
